ToneOptions.Label: Strategic & Forward-Looking
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Adopt a strategic, forward-looking tone emphasizing long-term IT infrastructure resilience and competitive advantage.

ToneOptions.Label: Data-Driven & Analytical
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Employ a data-driven, analytical tone highlighting the ML-powered insights and operational efficiencies achieved.

ToneOptions.Label: Risk-Focused & Proactive
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Utilize a risk-focused, proactive tone to underscore the system's ability to prevent critical IT failures.

ToneOptions.Label: Technically Proficient & Authoritative
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Maintain a technically proficient and authoritative tone, demonstrating deep understanding of ML and infrastructure management.

GoalOptions.Label: Enhance Uptime
GoalOptions.Text: The primary goal is to significantly reduce unplanned IT infrastructure downtime. Success is measured by a quantifiable decrease in critical incident tickets and a measurable improvement in overall system availability, directly impacting business continuity and revenue.

GoalOptions.Label: Optimize Operations
GoalOptions.Text: Achieve greater operational efficiency within the IT infrastructure management team. Success means reducing manual intervention for issue detection and resolution, freeing up skilled personnel for strategic initiatives and innovation.

GoalOptions.Label: Mitigate Risk
GoalOptions.Text: Proactively identify and mitigate potential IT infrastructure failures before they cause business disruption. Success is defined by the system's ability to accurately predict and alert on impending issues, thereby preventing data loss, security breaches, and service outages.

GoalOptions.Label: Drive Innovation
GoalOptions.Text: Leverage advanced ML capabilities to transform IT operations from reactive to predictive. Success is demonstrated by the adoption of ML-driven insights to inform infrastructure investments and strategic planning, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Commercial Impact
Criteria: Quantifiable reduction in operational costs due to fewer incidents.
Demonstrable improvement in service level agreement (SLA) adherence.
Positive impact on business continuity and revenue protection.
Alignment with overall IT budget and investment strategy.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical Performance
Criteria: Accuracy and precision of ML failure prediction models.
Scalability and performance of the data ingestion and processing pipeline.
Integration capabilities with existing IT monitoring and management tools.
Low false positive/negative rates for alerts generated.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Operational Readiness
Criteria: Clarity and actionability of alerts for IT operations teams.
Ease of deployment and maintenance of the ML inference system.
Robustness and reliability of the underlying infrastructure.
Adequacy of documentation and training for support staff.
